input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full and is favourable to us. §24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without Vendor consent (prompt notice only), and §13.3 carries the same carve-out through to licence rights. §24.2 restricts Vendor: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, financially sound assignee), and never to a direct Customer competitor. §24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control, so no walk-away trigger exists. §24.3's mutual consent standard for other assignments is symmetrical and not unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. The only other assignment-adjacent termination right (§9.2 insolvency) is mutual and expressly excludes a lawful reorganization that does not impair performance. No redline needed.
